say:3:1013414001:3.text: Turn back, now. You know well enough that what I've shown you so far is just a warning.
say:3:1013414001:3.source_cn: 咻——听我一句劝，打道回府吧。你应该很清楚，我的鞭子只...

say:4:1013414002:1.text: Why are you still in my way?

say:5:1013414003:1.text: I'm begging you to pause, the Sun Temple poses grave risks for you. Why would you want to risk your life like this?
say:5:1013414003:1.source_cn: 不是阻止你前进——是请求你停下。日神殿对你很危险，这只...

say:6:1013414004:1.text: Especially since I've seen you weak and near death before...
say:6:1013414004:1.source_cn: 我又不是没见过你虚弱濒死，躺在病床上的样子……

say:7:1013414005:1.text: I'm much stronger now than before.
say:7:1013414005:1.source_cn: 我已经比当初强大很多了。

say:8:1013414006:1.text: ...I know. But I can't help but feel concerned.

say:9:1013414007:1.text: Don't get it confused. Why do you think I said that to reassure you?
say:9:1013414007:1.source_cn: 别搞错了。你为什么觉得我说这种话是为了让你放心？

say:10:1013414008:0.text: You can't stop me. The past won't repeat itself. All along this journey, you've been complicating things.
say:10:1013414008:0.source_cn: 我是在告诉你，你绝无胜算。当年之事不会再重演。请别说我...

say:11:1013414009:1.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒，你甚至都不让我放过你。

say:12:1013414010:1.text: Come on! Who was in the middle of everything back then? Who's still stuck in a cycle of self-punishment with silly, strict rules?
say:12:1013414010:1.source_cn: 你更该放过自己！当年的事，到底谁在处处纠缠？是谁日复一...

say:13:1013414011:1.text: That is what I deserve. I once neglected Dura, disregarding the rules of the Templar Knights. Now, it's time for me to make amends...
say:13:1013414011:1.source_cn: 这是我应得的——我曾辜负艾雅，将圣堂骑士的守则抛诸脑后...
